name: AdvancedIF
intro: AdvancedIF 含 1,645 个人工编写对话及人工量规，覆盖显式复杂指令、多轮上下文延续和系统提示可控性。提示只在模型末轮出现指令遵循失败时保留；o3-mini 逐条判断量规，回答必须满足全部准则才算通过。
build_method: 专家人工提示与量规, 对抗式失败筛选
metric: 全准则严格通过率（CIF、CC、SS及三类平均）
task_type: 生成, 对话, 指令遵循
eval_feature: 6+复杂约束, 多轮上下文延续, 系统提示可控性, 逐量规二元判断
scale: 1,645个对话（复杂指令402、多轮上下文736、系统提示507）
build_method_en: Expert-written prompts and rubrics, adversarial failure filtering
eval_feature_en: 6+ complex constraints, carried multi-turn context, system-prompt steerability, criterion-level binary judging
intro_en: AdvancedIF contains 1,645 human-written dialogs and human-written rubrics spanning explicit complex instructions, carried multi-turn context, and system-prompt steerability. A prompt is retained only when the model fails instruction following at the final turn; o3-mini judges every rubric criterion and the response passes only if all criteria are satisfied.

drawio_review_note: REDRAW aligned with arXiv:2511.10507v2 §§3.1–3.2 and Table 1. The 402 complex single-turn prompts and the 736 carried-context plus 507 system-steerability dialogue branches all produce a provided LLM final response before adversarial failure retention. The same annotator authors up to 20 final-turn binary rubric criteria; the paper discloses multiple human review rounds for rubrics, not a parallel review claim for prompts, and criterion ordering is not disclosed. The release contains 402 + 736 + 507 = 1,645 dialogs. o3-mini receives conversation context, prompt, response, and rubric criterion; a dialog passes only when all criteria are true, and the reported CIF, CC, and SS scores are averaged.
